title: Cross-org Monthly Roadmap Deconflict and Risk Thermometer
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Objective: Produce a lightweight, repeatable monthly deconflict process and a visual 'risk thermometer' that product, eng, and design leads can use to prepare a concise exec readout. This ticket covers: 1) a standard agenda for a 45-minute cross-org alignment, 2) a one-page visual heatmap showing initiative health, runway, and top technical/operational risks, and 3) an escalation checklist and contingency lanes tied to capacity and SLA risks. The deliverable is a Confluence template + a one-slide executive summary template that can be used for QBRs and monthly stakeholder updates.
updates: 2026-02-20: Kickoff meeting with Eng (Riley Chen), Design (Maya Patel), and Platform Ops (Diego Ramos). Agreed scope and cadence: monthly, 45 minutes, pre-read distributed 48h before meeting.

2026-02-26: Draft heatmap prototype completed. Heatmap uses 4 axes: initiative progress, regression risk (quality), capacity risk (infra), and customer impact. Shared prototype for feedback in #pm-roadmap Slack.

2026-02-28: Engineering feedback (Riley Chen): request to include estimated mitigation lead time per risk and an auto-derived 'cost to mitigate' (approx tokens/GPU-hours) for infra-related risks. Added as optional column.

2026-03-03: Design critique (Maya Patel): recommended color palette for risk levels to align with accessibility guidelines and to ensure clear printing for board packets. Updated templates accordingly.
2026-03-06: PM review (Director of Product, Elena Gomez): suggested adding a short roll-forward ask section for each initiative (decision, resource ask, fallback). Incorporated.
2026-03-10: Prepared exec summary slide and Confluence template. Ran a dry-run with Growth PMs; two outstanding asks captured as follow-ups (ENG-562243, PM-558102).
Next steps: finalize automation to pull status from initiative trackers (see dependencies), publish template, and schedule training session for initiative leads ahead of the March monthly readout.
decision_log: Include mitigation lead time and cost estimate for infra risks — agreed 2026-02-28
Standard agenda set to: pre-read (48h), 10m highlights, 20m deep-dive on 2 medium-high risks, 10m escalation & asks, 5m action items — agreed 2026-02-20
Heatmap will include a single-line 'rollforward ask' per initiative for execs — agreed 2026-03-06
